title: Hint
text: A 95% confidence interval extends about $$2$$ SDs of the sample mean on each side of its center, so width of 95% CI $$=$$ $$4$$ * (population SD / sqrt(sample size)).

title: Hint
text: Set $$4$$ * $$0.2$$ / sqrt(sample size) $$ \leq $$ $$0.1$$ and solve for sqrt(sample size).

title: Hint
text: What is the smallest value sqrt(sample size) can be?
